items.title: Canvas comment as a Claude task
items.summary: In the original Tempo a canvas comment is only a note for people. Now every comment you post on a canvas also becomes a task for a Claude chat that works in the background while you stay on the canvas.

features.name: Canvas comment as a Claude task
features.what: Before: a comment was just text on the canvas and nothing happened. Now: when you post a comment (a new thread or a reply), a Claude chat is created and sent the comment, the pin position, the storyboard under it and the page. The task goes from queued to running to done.
features.how: Click the canvas in comment mode, write what you want (for example "add a blue square here") and press Post. Nothing else to do.

features.name: Runs in the background
features.what: Before: starting a chat moves you to the chat view. Now: the chat is created and started without leaving the canvas: same tab, same route, no chat view and no composer. The chat still appears in the chat list.
features.how: Automatic. Use Open chat in the bubble panel if you want to see the full chat.

features.name: Before / after captures and run GIF
features.what: Before: no record of what the change looked like. Now: the mod takes a screenshot of the commented area before the run, frames while it runs and one after, and builds a small looping GIF of the whole run. Panels and bubbles are masked out of the images.
features.how: Automatic. See the images in the bubble panel (Result).

features.name: Agent answer to a canvas comment
features.what: Before: the thread had only people's messages. Now: when the run ends, the agent's answer is posted in the comment thread with its name, model, before/after images and the GIF attached.
features.how: Automatic when a run is done. Turn off with localStorage rtd.commentAgent.reply = off.

items.title: Comment bubbles
items.summary: Next to the "Canvas page" pill there is now a row of small bubbles, one per comment you sent to an agent. Each bubble shows the status and opens a panel with what you asked and what the agent did.

features.name: Bubbles next to the Canvas page pill
features.what: Before: nothing showed which comments an agent was working on. Now: a counter ("3 open - 1 done today") and bubbles with the author's initials. The ring shows the status: amber with ? needs input, spinning Claude ring running, dashed queued, red ! failed, green check done.
features.how: Automatic. Alt-click a bubble to follow the agent.

features.name: Bubble tooltip
features.what: Before: none. Now: hover a bubble to see its number, author, status and request. A running agent shows its last captured frame, a done one shows the result.

features.name: Request panel
features.what: Before: none. Now: click a bubble to open a panel with You asked (comment and before image), Agent (steps), Result (before/after, run GIF, summary) and a footer to reply, open the chat, follow or dismiss.
features.how: Click a bubble. Escape or a click outside closes it. Hold Shift to peek at Before.

features.name: Answer an agent that needs input
features.what: Before: you had to find the chat. Now: when the agent asks a question, the bubble turns amber and the panel shows the question with an answer field already focused. The steps are folded into "N steps".
features.how: Click the amber bubble, type the answer, press Enter.

items.title: Agent cursors
items.summary: Agents that work on a comment now get a multiplayer-style cursor with a name tag on the canvas, in their own colour, like another person editing next to you.

features.name: Agent cursor with name tag
features.what: Before: you could not see where an agent was working. Now: each running task gets an arrow and a tag ("Claude - #1" or the model) that starts on the comment's pin, then glides to the storyboard that changed, outlines it and clicks.
features.how: Automatic while a task is running. Turn off with localStorage rtd.agentCursors = off.

features.what: Before: none. Now: parallel agents get different colours and tags (up to 8) and each moves only to its own storyboard.

features.name: Tag tooltip and needs-input balloon
features.what: Before: none. Now: hover the tag to read the comment and what the agent is doing; click it to open the bubble panel. When the agent waits for an answer an amber ? appears and the cursor stops moving. Finished cursors show a check and fade.
features.how: Hover or click the name tag.

items.title: Follow an agent
items.summary: Like Figma's follow mode: the canvas view pans and zooms by itself to keep an agent's work in frame.

features.name: Follow an agent (Alt-click)
features.what: Before: you had to pan and zoom by hand to watch an agent. Now: Alt-click a task bubble (or press Follow in its panel) and the view flies to the agent's storyboard, zooms to fit it with a margin and keeps following when the cursor moves. A chip at the top shows who you follow and a Stop button.
features.how: Alt-click a bubble, or Follow in the panel. Click Stop, press Escape, or Alt-click again to leave.

features.name: Pauses when you take over
features.what: Before: none. Now: if you click, pan or zoom yourself, follow pauses for 4 seconds so you keep control, then resumes. When the task ends the chip says Done and follow stops after 3 seconds.
features.how: Just use the canvas. Stop to end it.
